The main takeaway from our work is that
HA-chitosan scaffolds are promising materials for bone tissue engineering, and that their mechanical properties are suitable for bone regeneration.

the HA scaffolds with 50% of solids prepared by the gel casting method based on in situ polymerization of acrylamide monomers to form a porous body, were successfully coated with chitosan at different concentrations through a simple methodology of immersion for different times and under ambient conditions.
